name: duopore-public-property-document-checklist
description: See which property documents are ready and which still need work.

interface.longDescription: See which property documents are ready and which still need work. List the documents you want to prepare, choose the required ones and add their current status. Get a simple checklist for your next steps. You decide which documents belong on the list. The app does not determine legal document requirements or verify the papers.
defaultPrompt: Make a property document checklist from these statuses.
Which required property documents are still missing?
